subject: NimbleCart demo — quick qualification and scheduling
messages:
From: Samuel Reid <samuel.reid@nimblecart.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-19T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in a quick demo (self-serve sign-up)

Hi Vivek,

I signed up this morning and poked around the hosted API — looks promising for our use case. We're a two-person integration team at NimbleCart, and we're evaluating options for replacing our current embedding/search stack to improve product search relevancy.

Quick details:
- Current traffic: ~120k API requests/month (search queries + rerank).
- Peak concurrency: usually spiky during promotions, maybe 40 concurrent requests for short windows.
- Timeline: pilot in the next 4–6 weeks, production Q1 next year.

Would love a short 30 min walkthrough focused on embeddings + latency/cost tradeoffs and how Redwood handles prefix caching. Any availability next week?

Thanks,
Samuel
Sam Reid
NimbleCart — Head of Integrations
samuel.reid@nimblecart.io
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Reid <samuel.reid@nimblecart.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-19T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo (self-serve sign-up)

Hi Sam — great to meet you and glad you signed up. Quick questions so I can tailor the walkthrough and make the 30m count: 

1) Primary goal: are you evaluating for improving vector search relevance, reducing costs, or both? If both, which is the priority?
2) Embedding frequency: are embeddings generated on write (when content changes) or at query time? Approx. number of documents to embed (e.g., 1M docs).
3) SLA/latency target: p95 target for search queries? (e.g., <200ms)
4) Data sensitivity: will search inputs contain PII or regulated data?
5) Authentication/SSO: will you need SSO / SCIM for the pilot?

Can you answer briefly and then we can lock a slot. I have these 30m slots next week (PST):
- Tue 2026-09-22 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-09-23 14:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-09-24 09:00–09:30

If none work, tell me a couple times that do and I can loop Ben in to help with scheduling. I've attached a short pre-demo checklist that helps us prepare (what we typically ask for ahead of a pilot).

Attachment: redwood_pre-demo-checklist.pdf (outlined items: example corpus, sample queries, API key scopes)

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai
From: Samuel Reid <samuel.reid@nimblecart.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo (self-serve sign-up)

Thanks, Vivek — answers inline: 

> 1) Primary goal: are you evaluating for improving vector search relevance, reducing costs, or both?
Both, but relevance is slightly higher — customers complaining about poor ranking right now.

> 2) Embedding frequency / number of docs
We re-embed on content updates. Corpus size: ~850k product/variant records plus metadata (images stored separately).

> 3) SLA/latency target
We target p95 < 250ms for search (under normal traffic) and < 500ms during spikes is acceptable.

> 4) Data sensitivity
No regulated PII in payloads; product titles/descriptions only.

> 5) Authentication/SSO
Not required for the pilot; procurement will loop in if we head to contract.

For timing — Tue at 10:00 PST works for me. If possible can we make it 45 minutes instead of 30? We have two engineers who want to join.

Also, small ask on procurement: can you include a rough TCO estimate for 120k reqs/month in the meeting? If not exact, a ballpark is fine.

Best,
Sam
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Reid <samuel.reid@nimblecart.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-21T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo (self-serve sign-up)

Perfect — I've booked Tue 2026-09-22 10:00–10:45 PST and sent a calendar invite (link below). I'll run a focused demo of embeddings + search, show our caching/kv strategies for latency spikes, and bring ballpark cost estimates for ~120k queries/month. Ben (cc'd) will drop a short TCO note in the calendar file.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/invite/0x9aNimbleCart-demo
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (passcode: RedwoodDemo)

Action items for you before the call (optional but helpful):
- Share a small sample of 200 product rows and 10 representative queries (we can ingest via the Drive link).
- If you have any internal Qs on retention or audit logs, flag them now and we'll cover in the call.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
